scope: Deployment and operations audit, regression checks, and a recorded live Liara deployment

checks.name: TypeScript and production frontend
checks.command: npm run check && npm run build

checks.name: Unit and HTTP integration tests
checks.details: Includes source/job restoration, account isolation, failure stages and redaction, fresh approval on retry, malformed log-response handling, slow successful HTTP responses requiring investigation, and no mutation replay.

checks.name: Chrome recovery and navigation with simulated providers
checks.details: Drafts, source restore, direct job URLs, Settings return, Back/Forward, review regeneration, missing sources, late async responses and secret exclusion.

checks.name: Chrome failure screens with simulated providers
checks.details: Legacy HTTP 409, visible provider error and failed stage, edit/review retry, uncertain-outcome verification, 320px and 390px layouts; no browser errors or provider writes.

checks.name: Current Docker image and running app
checks.details: Cached Docker build passed TypeScript and production frontend checks. Restarted with no active jobs; /healthz returns HTTP 200. Credentials and team were reconnected, three Liara services synced, and the new frontend is served. Instance identity persisted, boot ID changed, and recovery was detected.

checks.name: Running app recovery in Chrome and HTTP
checks.details: Actual recorded test1 failure is visible; direct job URL survives refresh and Settings return. Saved source metadata and old-job endpoints return successfully. No browser errors.

checks.name: Live Liara app creation and deployment
checks.details: A dedicated Node.js app was created through the approved UI workflow. The actual deployment reached Liara release state READY, then passed three consecutive HTTP health checks. The result and website are recorded for the demo.

checks.name: Final Chrome regression audit
checks.details: Schedule load failures and retry; no overwrite before load; stale service and GitHub responses ignored; practice mode refresh/exit; no JavaScript errors or mobile overflow. Provider responses simulated for fault scenarios.

checks.name: Recorded practice diagnosis and approved recovery
checks.details: Injected HTTP503, inspected configuration-error log evidence, approved restore with exact-name confirmation, verified three health checks, and downloaded a resolved Markdown incident report.

checks.name: Live environment metadata with omitted disk information
checks.details: Liara omitted disks while returning valid environment data. Environment names now return HTTP 200; values remain hidden and attached storage remains explicitly unknown. Regression covered in the 106-test suite.

notRun: New-commit-triggered automatic GitHub deployment during the demo
Live destructive app deletion/stop or live failure injection during the demo
